scope: Saint-Michel / Ile de la Cite; material dimensions and appearances remain inferred

partial_landmark_assets.scope: Central and side portals, western rose and kings gallery; 2019 historical photo reconstruction. Sparse upper arcade/tower trials rejected.
partial_landmark_assets.limitations: 2.5D surfaces, bounded inferred completion and confidence-weighted sparse depth/colour regularization, provisional independent width/height registration, captured lighting remains. Does not satisfy the full exterior landmark requirement or surveyed L4/L5.

photographic_note: Six CC0 photographic appearance proxies and one HDR environment are bundled. Stone uses white_plaster_02 fine grain plus inferred limestone courses. Wood uses dark_wood at 2m scale with inferred outdoor roughness/patina, not cathedral timber or an identified species. Imported ORM is R=AO G=roughness B=metallic. DirectX normals. No geographic fidelity promotion.

required_assets.spec: 2K baseline / 4K focus; unlit albedo sRGB, DirectX normal linear, ORM linear, optional 16-bit height; physical tile size; clean and weathered variants
required_assets.evidence_required: Photo/source reference, license and redistribution terms; no baked lighting

required_assets.spec: Separate zinc and slate; 2K baseline / 4K focus; DX normal and ORM; seam/tile dimensions; distinguish exposed metal from oxide or dirt
required_assets.evidence_required: Roof reference photographs and rights; measured dimensions or explicitly labelled estimates

required_assets.spec: Wall, cornice, opening, balcony and dormer modules; centimetres, UV0, closed wall shells >=10cm for Lumen trials, explicit pivots; conventional LODs and separate collision
required_assets.evidence_required: Location/style reference per facade; actual source IDs preserved; procedural placement labelled inferred

required_assets.spec: Documented west facade, towers, buttresses and roof; modular static meshes, high-detail source plus fallback LOD and separate collision; preserve source footprint/anchor
required_assets.evidence_required: Survey/photogrammetry or documented photo references and redistribution rights; target L4/L5 requires corresponding evidence

required_assets.spec: Documented chapel exterior, roof and spire; split opaque stone and glass; cm scale, source anchor, fallback LOD and collision
required_assets.evidence_required: Documented references and rights; target L4/L5 requires corresponding evidence

required_assets.spec: Quay blocks, bridge arch/parapet modules; stone PBR, 2K / 4K focus, UVs and LODs; surveyed dimensions or labelled estimates
required_assets.evidence_required: Actual bridge ID and reference; do not replace measured centreline or water/terrain datum

required_assets.spec: Streetlights, benches, cafe furniture and trees; 3 conventional LODs, instancing-safe materials, simple collision; masked foliage with controlled overdraw
required_assets.evidence_required: Mapped OSM positions take priority; PCG placements carry inferred provenance

required_assets.available_subset: Two adult variants with original skin weights, 2K color/normal/specular inputs, approximate roughness, walk/idle/seated clips and three skeletal LODs. Bounded near pool; articulated proxies remain at distance and in low quality. Not scanned actual Paris residents or portrait-level MetaHumans.
required_assets.spec: Adult pedestrian models in cm; rig, walk/idle/sit/stand animation set, skin/clothing PBR, 3 LODs; <=30k triangles near, <5k medium; compatible foot contact and chair height
required_assets.evidence_required: Redistribution rights for meshes, textures and motions; simulated identities/occupancy remain inferred, no claim to scanned actual Paris pedestrians

packing_note: Existing ARH is R=AO G=roughness B=height; it is NOT ORM. Future ORM imports need a separate material binding; never use metallic as height.
